page.layout: One page of text, with a marginal note column on the right. Top: running title ornament and title block (DE / RATIONE CONTEXEN-DARVM EPI-STOLARVM, Pars I., italic subtitle), then the body in one column with a drop-cap opening. Right margin: one note beside the first paragraph. Foot of text: catchword centred under the last line.

main_text.l: gis, quàm de nota, quod aiunt, meliore eos,
à turpitudine ad honestatem flectere: ad
utilitatem traducere à damno: rogare: consolari:

note.i: De Delibera-tiui generis E-pistolis cur pri-mo loco aga-tur.

page.notes: Catchword "à" is at the foot, centred under the last line. The marginal note is printed in italic and split across four lines with hyphens; it is joined here as one note. The opening word is set in small capitals with a woodcut initial P, so it is given as PRINCEPS. The page number is printed as an old-style "1" at the head. The title "CONTEXEN-DARVM" and "EPI-STOLARVM" keep their printed hyphens.
